name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single, high-contrast focus ring that follows tab order—no exceptions. It works for keyboard users, screen readers, and touch devices by clearly showing focus without clutter. Trade-off: the ring must be thick enough to see on all backgrounds, which risks slightly obscuring nearby content.

name: Reader
text: The single high-contrast ring still risks obscuring critical content on dense screens, especially for users with low vision who rely on context. A better alternative is a semi-transparent ring with adjustable thickness and color, tested against WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios. Settle it by running a user test with screen-reader users on a complex screen—if any can’t complete their task due to obscured content, the alternative wins.
